# Universal Node Graph — Flexible Solutioning

> A domain-neutral graph programming, compilation, search, and experimentation architecture.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): Project overview and runnable examples
- [Getting started](GETTING_STARTED.md): Install, explore, author, validate, and contribute
- [Readiness](READINESS.md): Supported, experimental, unsafe, and unavailable surfaces
- [Normative specification](UNIVERSAL_NODE_GRAPH_SPEC.md): Required ontology and invariants
- [Research foundations](RESEARCH_FOUNDATIONS.md): Primary-source design rationale
- [AutoResearch and Cholesky review](AUTORESEARCH_REVIEW.md): Package identity, campaign isolation, lineage, promotion, and numerical nodes
- [LLM harness integration](LLM_HARNESS.md): Repository instruction and skill map
- [Node repository protocol](NODE_REPOSITORY_PROTOCOL.md): Reusable packs, descriptors, embeddings, handshake, snapshots
- [Node authoring guide](NODE_AUTHORING_GUIDE.md): Source-bound Python nodes, exact candidate expansion, standard-library reference, and publication checks
- [Solution template protocol](SOLUTION_TEMPLATE_PROTOCOL.md): Cross-domain stages, atomic slots, and bounded refinement
- [Task and solution-pack protocol](TASK_AND_SOLUTION_PACK_PROTOCOL.md): Stable task meaning, cases, oracle identity, and exact portable closure
- [Benchmark protocol](BENCHMARK_PROTOCOL.md): Controlled arms, holdouts, coverage, claim scopes, and evidence reports
- [Adoption guide](ADOPTION_GUIDE.md): Practical market wedge, integrations, LLM-harness loop, and production boundary
- [Execution protocol](EXECUTION_PROTOCOL.md): Frozen plans, runtimes, artifacts, recovery, verification, and receipts
- [Structured control](STRUCTURED_CONTROL_PROTOCOL.md): Conditional branches, composites, explicit bounded loops, and lowering receipts
- [Topology search](TOPOLOGY_SEARCH_PROTOCOL.md): Alternative DAG shapes, budgets, proposal lineage, and complete accounting
- [Streaming](STREAMING_PROTOCOL.md): Event-time windows, watermarks, lateness, retractions, and production boundaries
- [Provenance and resume](PROVENANCE_AND_RESUME.md): Exact local checkpoints and W3C PROV/OpenLineage/SLSA projections
- [Executable examples](REAL_WORLD_EXAMPLES.md): 37 runnable programs, 80 declared routes, controls, solver commands, and extension gates
- [Engineering DAG and DueCare harness showcase](ENGINEERING_DAG_AND_DUECARE_HARNESS_SHOWCASE.md): common engineering taxonomy, thirteen executable showcases, typed harness evidence, linked roles, feedback firewall, research anchors, and roadmap
- [Universal DAG Arena](UNIVERSAL_DAG_ARENA.md): 42 task families, 30 Arena-linked executable programs, solver profiles, and honest external boundaries
- [Extending the Arena](EXTENDING_ARENA.md): Required fixture, connector, catalog, conformance, and confirmation gates
- [Agent playbook](AGENT_PLAYBOOK.md): Patterns, anti-patterns, and implementation workflow
- [Full architecture blueprint](UNIVERSAL_GRAPH_SYSTEM.md): Extended design and viewer model
- [Workbench guide](WORKBENCH.md): Interactive hierarchical candidate explorer

## Code

- [Universal core](solutiongraph/): Semantic model, discovery, templates, compiler, structured control, topology search, adaptive allocation, campaign lineage, evidence
- [Reference executor](solutiongraph/executor.py): Strict plan recheck and replaceable runtime adapter boundary
- [Subprocess runtime](solutiongraph/subprocess_runtime.py): Bounded trusted-code lifecycle process adapter
- [Receipt journal](solutiongraph/ledger.py): Fsync-backed, content-chained local evidence persistence
- [Checkpoint protocol](solutiongraph/durable.py): Exact-identity completed-prefix persistence and resume
- [Structured compiler](solutiongraph/structured.py): Composite and bounded-loop lowering to ordinary DAGs
- [Topology search](solutiongraph/topology.py): Explicit graph variants plus compiler-valid route search
- [Streaming reference](solutiongraph/streaming.py): Finite event-time windows, watermarks, late data, and retractions
- [Saga runner](solutiongraph/saga.py): Reverse-order compensation over effectful node contracts
- [Compatibility sidecars](solutiongraph/compatibility.py): Optional port/state/secret/hardware/residency constraints
- [Provenance export](solutiongraph/provenance.py): W3C PROV, OpenLineage, and SLSA projections
- [Advanced conformance](solutiongraph/conformance.py): Installed-wheel execution of eleven advanced mechanisms
- [Workspace scaffold](solutiongraph/scaffold.py): Transactional coding-harness task initialization
- [Campaign contracts](solutiongraph/campaign.py): Hard budgets, population ancestry, evaluator boundaries, and decisions
- [Artifact stores](solutiongraph/artifacts.py): Content-addressed memory and local-file stores
- [Universal solver](solutiongraph/solver.py): Multi-round search, receipt-backed ranking, champion, and diverse route fallbacks
- [DAG Arena](solutiongraph/arena.py): Cross-domain problem catalog and executable suite harness
- [Python node authoring](solutiongraph/authoring.py): Source-bound definitions, signature checks, stable bindings, and exact finite expansion
- [Task/solution packs](solutiongraph/tasking.py): Portable task contracts, cases, oracle identity, and exact closure validation
- [Benchmark runner](solutiongraph/benchmarking.py): Controlled fixed/solver arms and offline JSON/HTML evidence
- [Standard-library nodes](solutiongraph/stdlib_pack.py): 19 dependency-free nodes, 32 bindings, discovery sidecars, and a 1,728-route data-quality program
- [Executable domain packs](solutiongraph/examples/): 37 trusted local programs and 319 nodes across data, streaming, GIS, APIs, frontend testing, rendering, web, documents, media, ML, identity, operations, security, science, synthetic data, reinforcement learning, and LLM evaluation
- [Example notebooks](notebooks/): Five end-to-end compile, execute, verify, and receipt notebooks
- [Wire schemas](solutiongraph/schemas/): JSON Schema 2020-12 contracts
- [Reference catalogue](catalog/): 31 semantic templates, five node packs, one linked-graph harness plus typed evidence closure, 42 Arena tasks, and six benchmark/solution packs
- [Browser adapter](browsergraph/): Concrete runtime proof
- [Universal conformance tests](tests/test_solutiongraph.py): Executable architecture requirements
- [Create-template skill](.agents/skills/create-solution-template/SKILL.md): Strict template authoring workflow
- [Author-node-pack skill](.agents/skills/author-node-pack/SKILL.md): Reusable node publication workflow
- [Benchmark skill](.agents/skills/benchmark-solution-graph/SKILL.md): Route experiment workflow
- [Solution-pack skill](.agents/skills/package-solution-graph/SKILL.md): Exact task/case/oracle/asset closure workflow
- [Benchmark Arena skill](.agents/skills/run-benchmark-arena/SKILL.md): Controlled suite execution and reporting workflow
- [Node-library skill](.agents/skills/expand-node-library/SKILL.md): Reusable source-bound primitive expansion workflow
- [Execution skill](.agents/skills/execute-solution-graph/SKILL.md): Runtime and executable-domain workflow
- [AutoResearch campaign skill](.agents/skills/design-autoresearch-campaign/SKILL.md): Bounded generated-code improvement workflow
- [Topology-family skill](.agents/skills/design-topology-family/SKILL.md): Alternative graph-shape authoring and experimentation workflow
- [Structured-workflow skill](.agents/skills/author-structured-workflow/SKILL.md): Safe branch, merge, composite, and bounded-loop workflow
- [Universal solver skill](.agents/skills/solve-universal-dag/SKILL.md): Typed task-to-Arena implementation and evidence-backed route selection
- [Workspace modeling skill](.agents/skills/model-solution-graph/SKILL.md): End-to-end agent workflow
